description: issue #673: `who` (Sprites, R/0->turtle) reports the current turtle, which at top level (no `tell`/`ask`/`each`, all SP2+) is the single default main turtle. `who` equals `first turtles` because both denote the main turtle and turtle `==` compares the stable id (C3), not the JS wrapper instance. Binding `who` to `:here` first works around a pre-existing parser precedence limitation where a zero-arg reporter cannot be the immediate left operand of `==` (parser.ts, issue #151).
